title: Sporadic Stitch Census — Coverage Quickmap
body:
Purpose:
A lightweight, ad-hoc spreadsheet to capture temporary coverage gaps and quick owner handoffs across routing/endpoint surfaces for the next 72 hours. This is intentionally compact — we expect it to be used by 1) triage leads to reassign owners, 2) oncall to note temporary fallbacks, and 3) product-ops to surface follow-ups.

Snapshot notes (as of 2028-09-07 09:30 PT):
- Total routes sampled: 42 (hosted-api + dedicated fallbacks + regional mirrors)
- Immediate gaps flagged: 5 routes with no assigned backup owner for overnight PST window
- Cost-impacting routes: 2 (high token burn observed when fallbacking to larger model)

Table (Owner | Role | Region | Primary route | Backup route | Coverage window | Confidence | Notes | Action):
1) Lina Cho | product-ops | NA-West | /v1/generate-hosted | /v1/generate-dedicated-1 | 08:00-20:00 PT | high | primary has recent kernel update | none
2) Omar Patel | eng-sre | NA-West | /v1/chat-stream | /v1/chat-stream-fallback | 24/7 | medium | fallback throttled during burst; pending rate-limit tweak | PR: GH-PR-998
3) Sofie Nguyen | infra | EU-Central | /v1/embed | -- (none) | 09:00-17:00 CET | low | no backup in-region; relying on cross-region mirror | Action: identify temp backup by EOD
4) Diego Ramos | solutions | APAC | /v1/rerank | /v1/rerank-quantized | 00:00-08:00 SGT | medium | quantized variant sometimes degrades quality - watch alerts | Open: EVAL-233
5) Mei Tan | eng-serving-runtime | NA-East | /v1/streaming-large | /v1/streaming-small | 06:00-18:00 ET | high | small variant increases latency for long contexts | Note: test batching param change
6) Rajiv Bhat | customer-success | NA-West | /v1/customer-proxy | /v1/customer-proxy-failover | 12:00-00:00 PT | low | handover needed over weekend | Owner swap requested
7) Priya Shah | product-security | Global | /v1/private-deploy | -- | on-call overlap | medium | compliance check pending for mirror route | Follow-up: security review next week
8) Marcus Lee | eng-platform | NA-West | /v1/metrics-ingest | /v1/metrics-ingest-2 | 00:00-23:59 | high | replicated; occasional lag during spikes | Watch: replication-lag alert
9) Talia Rivera | devexp | EU-West | /v1/console-sso | /v1/console-sso-backup | 07:00-19:00 CET | medium | backup needs secret rotation | Action: schedule rotation
10) No backup assigned | - | NA-West | /v1/legacy-rewrite | -- | 00:00-06:00 PT | low | legacy path still used by 3 customers | Action: assign temp owner ASAP

Quick risk matrix (1-5 severity):
- Routes with no backup and customer-facing: 4 (severity 4)
- Routes with backup but low confidence (quantization/region mismatch): 7 (severity 3)
- Routes with cost spike on fallback: 2 (severity 3)

Immediate asks (to be actioned within 24 hours):
- Sofie: propose a temporary in-region backup for /v1/embed or confirm cross-region SLA (due 2028-09-07 17:00 CET).
- Product-ops (Lina): coordinate weekend owner for /v1/legacy-rewrite and confirm customer impact window (due 2028-09-07 18:00 PT).
- Eng-sre (Omar): roll out rate-limit tweak to chat-stream fallback in staging and report new headroom (due 2028-09-08 10:00 PT).
- Solutions (Diego): run quick quality spot-check against rerank-quantized for the last 24h traffic and flag regressions (due 2028-09-08 09:00 SGT).

Follow-ups (not blocking immediate rotation):
- Schedule a 30-minute cross-functional sync if more than 3 routes remain unbacked after initial actions.
- Prep a short customer note (CC: Rajiv) if /v1/legacy-rewrite will be unbacked for >48h.
- Track any cost delta from fallback routing in next daily cost report (ref: COST-2028-09-07).

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Is there a fast path to provision a temporary backup model in-region (hw/availability)? (asked infra)
- Confirm whether fallback route selection should prefer lower-latency even if higher-cost for premium customers.

Change log (brief):
- 2028-09-07 09:30 PT - initial quickmap created by Lina Cho after ops morning scrub.
- 2028-09-08 11:12 PT - Omar updated chat-stream confidence and linked GH-PR-998.
- 2028-09-09 08:05 CET - Sofie noted in-region backup still open; escalated to infra lead.

Notes to triage lead: keep this sheet slim. If you need a durable tracking artifact, move resolved rows into the longer-lived "coverage-matrix" confluence page and close out linked tickets.

Row usage guidance: mark Confidence as high/medium/low. Update Notes with minimal context and link related tickets under Action/linked_artifacts. Use this doc for ephemeral coordination only.
